verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a fast one-line install (curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh), and a community user notes ROCm containers have shipped since 0.1.27, so quick installation is evidenced. Neither is a standard OS package manager. Missing for 10: evidence of installs via standard package managers (e.g. Homebrew, apt, winget), coverage of package-manager install across macOS, Windows and Linux, and independent hands-on corroboration of the package-manager install experience.
